meta.name: instagram-hashtag-posts
meta.description: Scrapes Instagram posts by hashtag, returning media items with captions, like/comment counts, media URLs and user info from the hashtag explore feed. Use when user mentions Instagram hashtag scraping, get posts by hashtag, IG hashtag feed, scrape Instagram by tag, hashtag posts Instagram, search Instagram hashtag, pull posts from hashtag, Instagram topic posts, trending hashtag content, Instagram tag posts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按话题标签抓取 Instagram 帖子数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要批量获取 Instagram 话题标签下的帖子内容
copy.tagline_en: Scrape Instagram posts by hashtag for media and engagement data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to collect Instagram posts by hashtag for analysis

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你给的 Instagram 话题标签，自动抓取该标签下的热门帖子，返回帖子内容、点赞数、评论数、图片或视频链接以及发布者信息。
howto.when: 当你提到要抓取 Instagram 话题标签的帖子，比如“获取 #travel 的帖子”、“搜索 Instagram 标签”等时触发。

say.text: 帮我抓一下 #travel 的 Instagram 帖子。
获取 #food 标签下的前 10 条帖子。
say.note: Claude 会抓取并展示帖子详情。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can scrape Instagram posts by a given hashtag, returning media items with captions, like/comment counts, media URLs, and user info from the hashtag explore feed.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention scraping Instagram hashtag posts, e.g., "get posts by #travel", "search Instagram hashtag", etc.

say_en.note: Claude will open Instagram and return top posts for that hashtag.
Claude will fetch and display post details.
